• "Leverage" means power or influence used to achieve a desired result. Its closest synonym among the options is "influence". (प्रभाव)

◦ Example: The union used its collective leverage (influence) to negotiate better wages for the workers.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Pervade" means to spread throughout or pass through something thoroughly — different in sense from "leverage".

• Option 2 "Incisive" means vigorous and sharply perceptive in expression or criticism — different in sense from "leverage".

• Option 3 "Promote" means to encourage the development or growth of something — different in sense from "leverage".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of leverage: influence. Antonyms: weakness, powerlessness.

question:

Provisional
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Temporary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Provisional" means arranged for the present but liable to change later; temporary. Its closest synonym among the options is "temporary". (अस्थायी)

◦ Example: The election commission released a provisional (temporary) list of candidates, subject to final verification next week.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2 "Anticipation" means a strong belief that something will happen or be the case — different in sense from "provisional".

• Option 3 "Surpass" means go beyond the limits of something; rise above — different in sense from "provisional".

• Option 4 "Harmful" means causing gradual but serious harm, often in a subtle way — different in sense from "provisional".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of provisional: temporary. Antonyms: permanent, final, definitive.
